description: Every incident-reporting clock an Indian entity owes — CERT-In six hours, the sectoral regulator (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, IFSCA), SEBI LODR, NCIIPC, DPDP — each with its trigger, recipient, channel and source clause. Give noticed_at to get wall-clock IST due times. Clocks run in parallel; none discharges another.

ifsca_exempt.description: IFSCA RE inside either exemption tier of the 2025 Guidelines.

ifsca_mii.description: IFSC market infrastructure institution (stock exchange, clearing corporation, depository).

listed.description: Listed on an Indian stock exchange.

nbfc_layer.description: For an NBFC: its layer under Scale-Based Regulation.

noticed_at.description: Optional. When the incident was noticed or brought to notice, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-10-01T14:30:00+05:30.

personal_data.description: The incident involves digital personal data.

protected_system.description: Operates a notified Protected System (brings NCIIPC).

sebi_broker_or_dp.description: SEBI stock broker or depository participant (adds a six-hour leg to the exchanges/depositories).

name: india_incident_reporting_deadlines
title: Indian cyber incident reporting deadlines
